zh: 每一步要取的是剩余元素中的最大值或最小值；如果数组已经有序，这两个值始终位于剩余区间的两端。
排序后用左右两个指针表示尚未使用的区间，交替从右端取最大、从左端取最小，每个元素恰好使用一次，重复值也会按出现次数保留。
将数组升序排序，l指向开头、r指向末尾；当l≤r时先输出a[r]并把r左移，若仍有l≤r再输出a[l]并把l右移，直到两个指针交错。
en: Each step takes either the largest or the smallest remaining element; once the array is sorted, these two always sit at the two ends of the remaining range.

After sorting, keep the unused range between a left and a right pointer and alternately take the largest from the right end and the smallest from the left end; every element is used exactly once, and duplicates are kept as many times as they occur.
Sort the array in ascending order with l at the start and r at the end; while l≤r, output a[r] and move r left, then if still l≤r output a[l] and move l right, until the pointers cross.

explanationEn:
## Approach

After sorting, use two pointers to alternately take the largest at the right end and the smallest at the left end until they meet.

## Proof of correctness

The two ends of the sorted range are exactly the largest and smallest of all unused elements; after each step removes the required end, the remaining range is still sorted, so by induction every position follows the required order and no element is used twice.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), output space O(n).
